subject.title: refactor: deduplicate micro helpers onto canonical homes

question: Should this protected, cross-subsystem helper consolidation proceed after maintainers confirm that each replacement preserves the caller-specific record, string, error, and escaping contract?
rationale: The patch touches 64 files across core, plugins, AI, gateway, security, and UI code, while the repository policy marks this item for maintainer handling; accepting a broadly shared semantic consolidation is not safely reducible to an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Approve after contract audit
options.body: Confirm representative nullability, type-guard, and escaping semantics at the shared-helper boundaries, then merge once real behavior proof is added.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Split any caller with intentionally distinct semantics into a smaller follow-up rather than forcing it onto a common helper.

options.title: Pause consolidation
options.body: Close or defer the refactor if the maintenance benefit does not justify cross-subsystem review and proof effort.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract audit
recommendation.body: Confirm representative nullability, type-guard, and escaping semantics at the shared-helper boundaries, then merge once real behavior proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history is needed to route the decision to the owner of the canonical normalization and regexp helper contracts.
